Chapter 6969: Just A Passerby

Chapter 6969: Just A Passerby

“Scram before it is too late.” Godfiend Monarch didn’t want to waste time on a mortal.

“You’re walking closer to death.” Li Qiye smiled.

“So be it.” Godfiend reached for Li Qiye.

“Damn it!” The emperors couldn’t do anything to help.

“Bam!” He smacked Li Qiye.

Everyone imagined the mortal being reduced to a bloody mist. However, Li Qiye was perfectly fine.

“Who are you?” Godfiend gazed at this unknown being.

“Just a passerby. It appears that you need a lesson.” Li Qiye said: “You may make the first move.”

“Let’s see what you can do.” Godfiend didn’t relent despite not seeing through Li Qiye. His godfiend aura erupted like a storm, paralyzing all inhabitants.

“What is going on?!” They panicked in confusion.

Many laypeople from the monastery felt it and wondered about their monarch’s battle. They knew this aura was the apex realm of their dao.

“Godfiend Saber!” He placed his palms together for a vertical swing, mimicking a saber. It cut through space and left an indelible scar.

The emperors knew this was enough to kill them. However, Li Qiye stopped it with two fingers to the monarch’s astonishment. He tried to pull back to no avail.

“You want to ascend despite only having this much power? Know your limit, don’t drag this world down with you.” Li Qiye said.

“Here’s another!” Godfiend’s aura poured down from the sky like an endless waterfall.

“Careful!” The emperors ordered their members to retreat upon seeing this.

“Godfiend Ascension!” The sky turned dark as he transformed into a radiant meteoric blade.

“No!” The inhabitants of Survivor Realm bellowed in horror.

This was his strongest move. If no one could block it, it could pierce through all of the monastery and cause devastating damage to Survivor Realm.

However, the blade paused before piercing Li Qiye’s chest. Everything came to a halt.

“Break!” Godfiend activated his powers and vitality, causing the blade to dazzle blindingly. This proved ineffective as if Li Qiye was made from the hardest metal.

Li Qiye waved and crushed the blade, bypassing the godfiend aura and sending the monarch flying. The latter crashed into the ground like a meteor.

“What...” The emperors couldn’t believe their eyes.

“An immortal?” Su Lianxin became frozen.

“Ugh...” Godfiend vomited a mouthful of blood; his legs trembled uncontrollably as he tried to stand: “W-who are you? An immortal?”

As an overlord, he had a keen awareness of the immortal power. Moreover, his godfiend style was an immortal dao.

Only an immortal could defeat him so effortlessly. However, he didn’t sense any dao fluctuation from Li Qiye.
